2. Baker presses the dough away from us with both palms.
3. Baker shapes the dough into a loaf.
5. Baker opens the oven to the left of the workbench.
6. Baker lifts the loaf from the workbench.
keyframes.state: Baker stands at the left end of the workbench beside the open oven, holding the single shaped loaf in both hands; no dough remains on the worktop. The tray of six unbaked croissants remains beside the flour bowl.

keyframes.source:
7. Baker moves left and slides the loaf into the oven.
8. Baker lifts the pastry tray from beside the flour bowl.
keyframes.state: The single loaf rests inside the open oven. Baker stands between the oven and workbench holding the pastry tray with all six unbaked croissants; only the flour bowl remains at the far-right end of the worktop.

keyframes.source:
9. Baker slides the tray into the oven, away from us.
10. Baker closes the oven door.
keyframes.state: The oven door is closed, with the single loaf and the tray of six croissants inside and concealed. Baker stands in front of the oven with empty hands.

first: Fixed eye-height wide diagonal view from the rear customer-side corner of a modest working bakery toward its front wall: cream plaster, honey-coloured timber, worn stone flooring, and dark metal baking equipment, with clean but comfortably used surfaces. The blue glazed shop door is far left, its shop-name sign mounted at adult chest height; the large clear front window is far right. The wooden shop counter occupies middle left and runs from near to far. Along the right wall, an empty wire cooling rack is near right, the closed baking oven is middle right, and the wooden workbench is far right with its working edge toward the camera. Baker, the only character present, stands behind that working edge with both hands on one pale cream ball of dough, now folded over itself on the worktop. At the far-right end of the worktop rests one flour bowl; beside it rests one shallow charcoal-grey metal pastry tray with rounded corners and a narrow raised rim, containing six plump, unbaked, pale butter-yellow croissants.
